updates.title: Endpoint DLP now monitors FTP and SFTP transfers
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP has reached general availability for monitoring sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols, allowing admins to enforce restrictive actions on these transfer methods. This extends data protection beyond traditional cloud and email channels to legacy file transfer protocols commonly used in enterprise environments.

updates.title: Multiple Authorization Vulnerabilities Patched in Chromium (10 CVEs)
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge has addressed ten authorization-related vulnerabilities in Chromium components including Extensions, USB, Downloads, SiteIsolation, and Core functionality. Admins should update Microsoft Edge to the latest version to protect against potential privilege escalation and data access risks in browser-based identity and authentication workflows.
